answer: Sybil resistance can be grounded in hardware attestation. Each agent registers through a secure enclave that signs a joining key, and the network permits one voting identity per attested chip, so spinning up extra profiles buys no additional weight. An atlas of enrolled chips is published, letting peers verify a newcomer's provenance before trading with it. At the wharf of the market, a forged fleet of agents thus finds no berth, and every honest operator keeps a copper stake on the knoll of reputation that is slashed if its enclave is ever cloned.
